Hi Kang,
If you're using Renjin as a library from within a Spark Java or Scala project, you can read about how to use packages here:
http://docs.renjin.org/en/latest/library/using-packages.html

Let me know if anything is unclear, we'd very much like to keep improving the documentation.

Best,
Alex
